description: Maine ID card, layout taken from an issued credential. Identity values replaced with generic stand-ins; expectedBytes regenerated by the encoder under me-issued-v09.

provenance.source: PDF417 barcode decoded from a photo of the back of an issued Maine identification card (AAMVA v09, IIN 636041). Layout only; identity values are synthetic.
provenance.verifiedBy: Claude Code (zxing-cpp decode of the source image; two independent preprocessing passes agreed byte-for-byte). Before anonymization, generateAAMVAPayload under me-issued-v09 in strict mode reproduced all 303 source bytes exactly, and identifyObservedEncodingProfile selected me-issued-v09 from them.
provenance.anonymization: Names, customer ID (DAQ), address, document discriminator (DCF), inventory control number (DCK), dates, card revision date (DDB) and physical descriptors (DAU/DAW/DAY/DAZ/DBC) are generic stand-ins. DCF keeps the source's 25-character zero-filled width and DCK its 17-character width. expectedBytes are produced by generateAAMVAPayload with encodingProfileId me-issued-v09, not by patching the decoded symbol in place.
provenance.notes: Opt-in via encodingProfileId me-issued-v09, scoped to ID cards. Default Maine generation is unchanged. The source directory declared ID at 41 for 256 bytes and ZM at 297 for 6 (303 total, exactly contiguous). The profile records jurisdiction version 00, the issuer element order (each name element followed by its truncation flag; DAZ and DAW between DCK and DDA), an unpadded 9-digit DAK, no separator before each subfile terminator, and a ZM subfile written even though its only element, ZMA, is empty. The card carried no DCA/DCB/DCD, DAH, DCU, DDK or DDL. ZMA's meaning is unpublished and not inferred.
